limitations: Current fixed-wing program identity is distinct from a verified launch coordinate.
Neighboring-state inventories remain incomplete; county results cover only bases already mapped.
Generalized county boundaries are not cadastral surveys.
75 NM geographic overlap is not guaranteed service availability.
